Current-operator assignment and reassignment preserve other fields and record actor, time and exactly the assignee notices.

clauses.title: Changes, rejection, and cancellation
clauses.text: Requesting changes on an unresolved decision requires a rationale of at least one non-whitespace character, records the operator and the time, and sets the decision to In review. Rejecting or canceling an unresolved decision also requires such a rationale and is a terminal outcome under DEC-004. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-write-effects.mjs and tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs. Nonblank rationale, attributed In review transition and terminal rejection/cancellation with unchanged linked risks.

clauses.title: Linked-risk effect
clauses.text: A decision outcome changes its linked risk only through the resolution policy, and no other decision action changes a risk. *Policy: `decision.resolution.v1`; default: approving moves a linked risk from Needs decision or Escalated to In progress; requesting changes, rejecting, and canceling leave it unchanged. No decision outcome resolves a risk.* *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-write-effects.mjs and tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs. Only approval of Needs decision or Escalated risks moves them to In progress; other actions preserve risks and none resolve them.

clauses.title: Finality
clauses.text: A terminal decision cannot be edited into another outcome; such a request is rejected and changes nothing. An operator can create a new decision that supersedes it under DEC-001, and each decision links to the other on both details. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-write-effects.mjs and tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs. All terminal states refuse edits; superseding decisions have reciprocal detail links at 1440 and 390.

clauses.title: Definition
clauses.text: A lens has a name, a description, exactly one record type from Campaign, Risk, Milestone, or Decision, at most 20 conditions, a sort order, visible fields, and a display mode valid for its type: Grid for Campaign, Cards for Risk or Decision, Timeline or Agenda for Milestone. A lens with a mode its type does not allow is rejected on save. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-write-effects.mjs and tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs. All supported record/display pairs, required definition fields and the 20-condition limit through preview/save.

clauses.title: Preview
clauses.text: Lens preview evaluates the unsaved definition against non-archived records, reports the exact matching count under VIEW-007 within 2 seconds, changes no record, and shows an explicit zero-results state. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-write-effects.mjs and tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs. Exact unsaved previews within two seconds, archive exclusion, unchanged storage and explicit zero-result screens at 1440 and 390.

clauses.title: Save and share
clauses.text: Saving a lens makes it available to every operator and records who saved it and when. Sharing produces a URL to the saved lens that requires an operator session; no lens URL is readable without one. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-write-effects.mjs and tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs. Saver identity/time, availability to another operator and session-protected working share URLs at 1440 and 390.

clauses.title: Edit and delete
clauses.text: An operator can edit a lens definition or delete the lens. Neither changes, archives, or deletes any record the lens displays or hides. A shipped lens cannot be deleted. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-write-effects.mjs and tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs. Definition edits/deletion preserve every business record; shipped lens deletion is refused.

clauses.title: Current results
clauses.text: Opening or refreshing a lens re-evaluates it against non-archived records, and its result list, count, condition summary, and selected detail all describe that one evaluation. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — Saved lens opening and refresh materialize one definition revision, non-archived result set, count, condition summary and selected detail; current authority, edits, archival and explicit empty states are exercised at 1440/390. Evidence: `tests/launch-write-effects.mjs`, `tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`.

clauses.title: Shipped views
clauses.text: Risks Lens and Timeline Lens ship as saved lenses. Operators can duplicate or edit them, and restoring either returns its definition to exactly the one in RISK-005 or MILE-002 without changing a record. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-write-effects.mjs and tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs. Both installed shipped lenses support independent duplication, editing and exact definition restoration without business mutations.

clauses.title: Conditions
clauses.text: A condition names one field of the lens's record type — campaign custom fields only on a Campaign lens — and one operator from equals, not equals, one of, contains, is empty, is not empty, before, after, and within the next N days, typed to that field: contains applies to text fields only, and the date operators to date fields only. Conditions combine with AND. A condition naming an unknown field, or an operator its field's type does not support, is rejected on preview and on save. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-write-effects.mjs and tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs. Typed field/operator validation on preview and save, campaign-only custom fields and AND combinations.

clauses.title: Campaign activity
clauses.text: Campaign activity is ordered newest first. It records every create, field change, archive, restore, and delete of the campaign and of its deliverables, milestones, risks, decisions, and comments, plus every import and every mutation made by an automation. Each entry carries its type, its subject's ID, the operator or the automation run that acted, the time, and for a field change the field name with its previous and new value. Campaign activity is the operator-visible view of the audit records in `BASE-OPS-005`: deleting a campaign removes this view, and those audit records survive with the campaign reference anonymized. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs.

clauses.title: Comments
clauses.text: An operator can add a plain-text comment to a campaign, and it appears in campaign activity. A comment changes no field of any record and triggers no automation and no AI call. An operator can delete a comment, which leaves a deletion entry in activity. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — Plain-text comment creation and versioned deletion, attributed activity, current authority, and complete business/automation/AI isolation through native HTTP commands and 1440/390 screens. Evidence: `tests/launch-write-effects.mjs`, `tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`.

clauses.title: Dates and times
clauses.text: Every timestamp in the API and the export is ISO 8601 in UTC. Campaign, deliverable, and milestone dates are calendar dates evaluated from the start of that day in the workspace timezone; decision due times are instants. Every relative time exposes its absolute time as its accessible name. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs.

clauses.title: Mentions
clauses.text: A comment can mention a current operator, which notifies exactly that operator and changes no field of any record. A mention of a removed or erased operator renders as plain text and notifies nobody. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — Only the mentioned current operator is notified; removed and erased mentions stay plain text without delivery or business-field changes, through native HTTP commands and 1440/390 screens. Evidence: `tests/launch-write-effects.mjs`, `tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`.

clauses.title: Definition
clauses.text: An automation has a name, one trigger, an ordered list of actions, an enabled state, and a definition version that increments on every edit. A trigger is a product event declared in `seed.json → extensionPoints.events` or a schedule of at most one run per hour, and a shorter schedule is rejected on save. An action is one of `escalate-risk`, `create-decision`, `notify-operator`, `send-email`, `request-ai-analysis`, and `add-activity`, plus any command contributed through `jobs.commands.v1`. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* partial — implemented in src/apps/launch/automations.server.ts; no clause-tagged test yet.

clauses.title: Commit boundary
clauses.text: An event automation is dispatched within 10 seconds of the mutation that raised its event committing. A rolled-back mutation dispatches nothing. A disabled automation runs on neither events nor schedules and records no run. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-runtime.mjs.

clauses.title: One run per trigger
clauses.text: One run exists per automation, definition version, and trigger event or scheduled instant; transport retries are attempts inside that run. Under `BASE-OPS-003`, a redelivered message reuses each action's idempotency key, so no decision, notification, analysis, or activity entry is created twice. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-event-control.mjs; tests/launch-installed-runtime.mjs.

clauses.title: Definition changes
clauses.text: A run records the definition version that created it. Editing an automation affects only later triggers. Disabling one cancels queued runs that have not started, recording each as Canceled with no action executed. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-event-control.mjs; tests/launch-installed-network-cancel.mjs.

clauses.title: Loop protection
clauses.text: Every mutation made by an automation carries the ID of the run that made it, and a run inherits its cause's chain of run IDs. An event whose chain already contains a given automation starts no new run of it, and the suppression is recorded on the causing run. A chain is at most 10 runs deep, and an eleventh is recorded as Suppressed and not dispatched. Two runs triggered by the same event may finish in either order and neither waits for the other. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-event-control.mjs.

clauses.title: Run history
clauses.text: Every run records its automation version, trigger, subject, queued, started, and finished times, each attempted action with its result, the number of records it affected, and the error code and message of any failure. Run history is retained in full and paged under VIEW-007, and Automation Monitor shows each automation's success rate as finished successful runs divided by finished runs over the trailing 30 days, stating that window. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* partial — implemented in src/apps/launch/automation-runtime.server.ts; no clause-tagged test yet.

clauses.title: Transport retry
clauses.text: An action with a transport failure known to be safe to retry is retried at 1, 5, 15, 30, and 60 minutes after its first failure. A retry re-executes only actions that have not completed and reuses their idempotency keys. When the fifth retry fails the run is marked Failed. An uncertain external outcome, including an uncertain SendGrid submission, leaves the action and run visibly Unknown with their error code and message; neither automatic nor manual retry resends it. A retained action key alone does not establish provider-side idempotency or a safe resend. The [14 October clarification](docs/launch-runtime.md#uncertain-delivery-contract--14-october-2026) records this owner-accepted exception to the former unconditional transport retry promise. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-retries.mjs.

clauses.title: Failure that retrying cannot fix
clauses.text: A validation error, a policy rejection, a schema failure, or a provider refusal fails the run immediately with no retry. Every Failed run is listed in Automation Monitor with its error code and message under `BASE-OPS-004`. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-event-control.mjs.

clauses.title: Manual retry
clauses.text: An operator can retry a Failed run. The retry is a new run linked to the original by `retryOf` that reuses the original action idempotency keys, so completed actions do not repeat, and the original run stays Failed and unchanged. Unknown runs are ineligible; manual retry cannot bypass AUTO-007's uncertain-outcome restriction. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-retries.mjs.

clauses.title: Fan-out
clauses.text: A mutation that changes many records at once — a bulk edit under CAMP-013 or a committed import under IMPORT-003 — dispatches at most one run per enabled automation, carrying the affected record IDs, rather than one run per record. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* partial — implemented in src/apps/launch/bulk.server.ts; no clause-tagged test yet.

clauses.title: Shipped automations
clauses.text: The seed ships four automations. Critical risk escalation triggers when a risk's severity becomes Critical while the risk is open and not already Escalated, and its one action escalates that risk under RISK-003; it is enabled by default. Launch readiness runs on the schedule in MILE-004 and is enabled by default; its lead time, 5 days by default, and its evaluation hour, 08:00 by default, are editable in settings. Campaign brief triggers when a campaign is created or updated, at most once per campaign per hour, skipped when nothing in its AI-002 context changed since the last brief; it is enabled by default and dispatched only while AI is enabled under SET-002. The weekly portfolio digest runs on the schedule in NOTIFY-004 and is disabled by default. No other parameter of a shipped automation is editable, and each can be disabled. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-runtime.mjs; tests/launch-installed-schedules.mjs.

clauses.title: In-app events
clauses.text: An operator receives an in-app notification when a decision is assigned to them, when they are mentioned in a comment, when a Critical risk is escalated on a campaign they own, when a readiness request is created for them, and when an automation run they started fails. A Failed run that no operator started notifies the owner of the campaign it acted on, or every operator when the run has no campaign subject. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* partial — implemented in src/core/features/notifications; no clause-tagged test yet.

clauses.title: Email delivery
clauses.text: Every in-app notification has an email counterpart routed by the delivery policy through `mail.sender.v1` against the workspace quiet hours in settings, which default to 18:00–08:00 in the workspace timezone. Authentication email and the weekly digest are never held. *Policy: `notification.delivery.v1`; default: a Critical risk escalation or a decision assignment is emailed within 60 seconds at any hour; every other email raised during quiet hours is held and sent within 60 seconds of quiet hours ending, as one message per operator.* *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* partial — implemented in src/core/features/notifications; no clause-tagged test yet.

clauses.title: Delivery failure
clauses.text: Every outbound email has a delivery record linked to its notification and, when an automation sent it, to that run. A failed send, including an asynchronous bounce, is retried on the AUTO-007 schedule subject to its safe-retry requirement and then marked failed on both the delivery record and the notification, where settings lists it. An uncertain submission remains visibly Unknown under AUTO-007, rather than being treated as a confirmed failure that permits resend. SendGrid acceptance is not proof of mailbox delivery. The in-app notification stays available. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* partial — implemented in src/core/features/notifications; no clause-tagged test yet.

clauses.title: Digest
clauses.text: When enabled, the weekly digest is sent within 15 minutes of 09:00 each Monday in the workspace timezone to the configured recipients, defaulting to every current operator, and once per recipient address however often that address appears. It itemizes non-archived campaigns, launches in the next 30 days, open High and Critical risks, unresolved decisions, and runs that failed in the previous 7 days. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-schedules.mjs.

clauses.title: Inbox
clauses.text: The notification inbox lists an operator's notifications newest first and the navigation shell shows their unread count. A notification is unread for an operator until that operator opens it, an operator can mark one or all of their notifications read, and one operator's read state never changes another's. A notification whose subject has been archived or deleted is shown as unavailable rather than linking to a missing record. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* partial — implemented in src/core/features/notifications; no clause-tagged test yet.

clauses.title: One per event
clauses.text: An operator receives at most one in-app notification and one email for a single product event however many of its roles they hold, is never notified of an action they took themselves, and a repeat of the same event on the same subject within 60 minutes updates the existing unread notification instead of creating another. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* partial — implemented in src/core/features/notifications; no clause-tagged test yet.

clauses.title: Muting
clauses.text: In settings each operator can mute any notification kind for themselves. Muting stops the email for that kind for that operator only; the in-app notification is still created, and delivery to every other operator is unchanged. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* partial — implemented in src/ui/settings/preferences-panel.tsx; no clause-tagged test yet.

clauses.title: Overdue decisions
clauses.text: A decision still unresolved 15 minutes after its due time notifies its assignee once, or its requester once when it has no assignee. Moving the due time later re-arms that notification once for the new time. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-schedules.mjs.

clauses.title: Analyses
clauses.text: An operator, or the shipped campaign-brief automation, can request a campaign brief, a risk readout, or a lens proposal. Each result is stored as an immutable AI analysis linked to its campaign, to the lens it was invoked from, or to its lens draft, marked as AI-generated wherever it appears, stamped with the time it was produced, and citing the ID and version of every entity in its input. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-runtime.mjs; tests/launch-installed-ui.mjs.

clauses.title: Context
clauses.text: *Policy: `ai.campaign-context.v1`; default: a campaign brief receives the campaign's standard fields and its linked deliverables, milestones, open risks, and unresolved decisions; a risk readout receives the result set of the lens it was invoked from, capped at 200 risks; a lens proposal receives the supported field definitions and the operator's prompt. Comment text and custom-field values go to none of the three.* *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-runtime.mjs; tests/launch-installed-event-control.mjs.

clauses.title: Human control
clauses.text: AI output never changes a field of any record: it never completes a deliverable, moves a milestone, escalates or resolves a risk, resolves a decision, saves a lens, or sends a notification. A lens proposal stays an editable draft until an operator saves it. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-runtime.mjs; tests/launch-installed-ui.mjs.

clauses.title: Provider and failure
clauses.text: AI calls go through `ai.provider.v1` with a 60-second timeout. A timeout, a response that fails its schema, or an unconfigured or unavailable provider stores no analysis and changes no field of any record. An operator-initiated request shows the provider's error code and message where it was requested; an automation-initiated one fails that run under AUTO-008. Every other automation, notification, mutation, and read proceeds unaffected. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-ai-failures.mjs.

clauses.title: Usage
clauses.text: Every AI call records its feature, model, input and output token counts, reported cost, subject, requesting operator or automation run, duration, and result. Settings shows call counts, token counts, and cost by day and by feature. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-ai-failures.mjs.

clauses.title: Daily ceiling
clauses.text: Settings holds a daily ceiling on AI calls, 200 by default, resetting at 00:00 in the workspace timezone. A call that would exceed it is refused with an error naming the ceiling, stores no analysis, and fails any run that requested it under AUTO-008. Non-AI work is unaffected. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-ai-failures.mjs.

clauses.title: CSV preview
clauses.text: An operator can import a campaign, deliverable, or milestone CSV within the upload limits under `BASE-INPUT-003` and the row limit in `seed.json → limits`. The file must be UTF-8, comma-delimited, and carry a header row; a byte-order mark is accepted and anything else is rejected with a parse error. Import requires an explicit mapping from columns to fields and, before any record changes and within 60 seconds at the row limit, shows the number of creates, updates, and unchanged rows, every row error, and for each updated row the fields that will change with their stored and incoming values. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-operator-doors.mjs; tests/ui-launch-operator-doors.mjs.

clauses.title: Merge keys
clauses.text: A campaign row creates or updates a campaign by its unique code; a deliverable or milestone row creates or updates by campaign code plus title, and is a row error when that campaign is not already in the workspace. A merge key repeated inside the file, and a reference to an owner or select value that does not exist, are row errors. A value that is empty or only whitespace never overwrites a stored value. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-operator-doors.mjs.

clauses.title: Commit
clauses.text: Confirm is available only when every row is valid; one invalid row blocks the whole file and there is no partial import. Confirming commits every previewed row in one transaction, records an import record, and writes one activity entry on every campaign it created, updated, or whose deliverables or milestones it changed; any failure rolls back every row. A committed import cannot be rolled back, which is why IMPORT-001 shows every field it will change. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-operator-doors.mjs.

clauses.title: Replay and staleness
clauses.text: Preview returns a token that expires 30 minutes after it is issued and that confirm requires, together with an idempotency key. A record matched by the preview that changed before confirm makes confirm return 409 and require a new preview. Replaying a confirm with the same key within 24 hours returns the original result and creates no second record and no second activity entry. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-operator-doors.mjs.

clauses.title: Stored file
clauses.text: The uploaded file is stored with its import record and is downloadable by any operator. Deleting the import record deletes the file within 5 minutes. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-operator-doors.mjs.

clauses.title: Settings area
clauses.text: Settings is one operator-only area with sections for the workspace (name, timezone, currency, quiet hours), operators, notification preferences, custom-field definitions, automations and digest recipients, AI, imports and failed email deliveries, and current usage against every limit in `seed.json → limits`. Changing a setting records the operator and the time and applies to work dispatched after the change; work already dispatched is unaffected. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/ui-launch-operator-doors.mjs.

clauses.title: AI configuration
clauses.text: AI is off until an operator enables it in settings while the configured `ai.provider.v1` adapter has every environment value in `seed.json → env`. While AI is off, an AI request is rejected with a message naming what is missing, the campaign-brief automation is not dispatched, and every other feature works unchanged. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-installed-runtime.mjs; tests/launch-installed-ui.mjs.

clauses.title: First run and sample data
clauses.text: *Changed on 19 October 2026: configured workspace details complete first run.* When the installation configuration sets the workspace name, timezone and currency (`WORKSPACE_NAME`, `WORKSPACE_TIMEZONE`, `WORKSPACE_CURRENCY`, as `rer setup` and RER Managed hosting do), those are the owner's confirmed details: first-owner initialization stores them and records first run complete, so the owner's first sign-in opens `/app`. Otherwise a new deployment directs signed-in app visits to `/setup` until the owner confirms workspace details; completion survives setup reruns, and completed `/setup` visits open `/app`. It starts with the operator configured at setup, the configured timezone and currency, the two shipped lenses, the four shipped automations, and no campaigns, and every surface shows the empty state in VIEW-004. An operator can install and remove sample data in one action from settings; removal deletes only records the sample created and is refused, naming them, once any of those records has been edited. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/launch-operator-doors.mjs.

clauses.title: Export contents
clauses.text: In addition to the archive guarantees in `BASE-DATA-001`, the export contains every workspace setting, operator, campaign, tag, custom-field definition and value, deliverable, milestone and dependency, risk, decision and supersede link, lens, comment, activity entry, notification, delivery record, automation definition and run, import record, AI analysis, and AI usage record as JSON, and every stored import file in its original form. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* partial — implemented in src/domains/portability/archive.server.ts; no clause-tagged test yet.

clauses.title: CSV export

It is a one-way download and creates no sync relationship with any external system. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* done — tests/ui-launch-operator-doors.mjs.

clauses.title: Capacity limits
clauses.text: A create, invitation, or import that would take the workspace past a limit in `seed.json → limits` is rejected with 409 naming the limit, its value, and the current count, and changes nothing. No record, row, or field is silently dropped or trimmed. *Acceptance:* A clause-tagged test through the launch HTTP transport or emitted worker (`tests/launch-*.mjs`) or the operator walkthrough at 1440 and 390 (`tests/ui-launch-walkthrough.mjs`). *Status:* partial — implemented in src/apps/launch/storage.server.ts; no clause-tagged test yet.
